set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM modules/surface shared native sampling APIs.
Consumer: plsneuro E1.8 bd-01M1SC7118X4D4MM24RRYVJX0X and E4.9 linked result inspection (foreign-store provenance only).
Evidence: SurfaceSampling.scala keeps samplePoints/worldPoint/nearestGrid private; SurfaceSampleResult exposes values and counts only. SurfaceVolumeProjection.scala adds aggregate performance/quality receipts but no per-vertex requested/accepted locations. SurfaceWorldLink maps geometric vertices rather than the actual midpoint/ribbon sampling footprint. A consumer cannot accurately show which volume locations contributed to a projected vertex without duplicating the native sampling algorithm.
Scope: expose typed opt-in per-vertex sampling evidence from the same provider implementation that computes values. Record requested world locations, selected voxel IDs/coordinates, accepted/masked/out-of-bounds status and contribution semantics for the declared aggregation. Define handling of nonfinite values and repeated voxel hits. Support lazy or per-vertex queries to avoid mandatory all-mesh allocation. Existing ordinary sample API remains reusable; no application-specific branches.
Acceptance: JVM and Scala.js tests with independent asymmetric/oblique fixtures cover white/pial/midpoint/fractional/normal paths, masks, out-of-bounds, duplicate samples and nonfinite inputs. Receipts reconstruct the native sampled values/counts under each supported aggregation. A consumer can link a selected projected vertex to the actual contributing volume footprint, with undefined coverage explicit. Adopt only after native both-platform tests and downstream projection/picking evidence.
set.title: Expose typed per-vertex volume-to-surface sampling footprints
